title: Kirk Bondad reunites with Josh Yugen at Mister International 2026 in Bangkok
summary: Reigning Mister International Kirk Bondad, the second delegate from the Philippines to bring home the title, has reunited with Filipino publisher, publicist and entrepreneur Josh Yugen in Thailand…

blocks.text: Reigning Mister International Kirk Bondad, the second delegate from the Philippines to bring home the title, has reunited with Filipino publisher, publicist and entrepreneur Josh Yugen in Thailand where he posted his victory last year. The two were part of the selection committee at the preliminary competition of the 2026 Mister International contest held at MCC Hall at The Mall Lifestore in Bangkok on Thursday evening, Sept. 24. Yugen, also the Miss Universe national director for Pakistan, Egypt and Sweden, was appointed as vice president for global partnerships and member of the executive board of the Mister International Organization in 2025, […]...
